compressed_economic_rules.name: OBJECTIVE_LOSS_AND_TRANSFER_BASE
compressed_economic_rules.definition: Reuse the frozen mother event without alteration: a fresh causal 120-session low, a ceiling frozen from anchor offsets 0 through 9, at least one full-float-equivalent of PIT turnover strictly before resolution, and at least 10% old-high repair headroom.
compressed_economic_rules.economic_meaning: A completed loss of support followed by real ownership transfer creates an objective price-memory structure rather than a subjective candle pattern.

compressed_economic_rules.name: FIRST_RESOLUTION
compressed_economic_rules.definition: Reuse the frozen first eligible close above the frozen base ceiling; the signal session itself is never fillable.
compressed_economic_rules.economic_meaning: The stock first attempts to leave the transferred ownership base.

compressed_economic_rules.name: NEXT_SESSION_ACCEPTANCE
compressed_economic_rules.definition: The first lineage-valid, hard-valid, tradable completed symbol session in signal+1 through signal+3 must close strictly above the frozen base ceiling. Enter only at the first legal non-limit-up open in the next three market sessions after that confirmation. If the frozen old-high target was already reached before entry, do not enter.
compressed_economic_rules.economic_meaning: A real resolution must remain accepted after one additional completed auction cycle; a signal-bar print alone is insufficient.

compressed_economic_rules.name: BASE_CEILING_DYNAMIC_INVALIDATION
compressed_economic_rules.definition: After T+1, the first lineage-valid completed session whose close is strictly below the frozen base ceiling creates an exit instruction. Fill at the next legal non-limit-down open; do not replace the instruction with a later target hit.
compressed_economic_rules.economic_meaning: Falling back into the transferred base falsifies the same price-discovery hypothesis that justified entry.

compressed_economic_rules.name: CAUSAL_TARGET_AND_TIME_LIMIT
compressed_economic_rules.definition: Before invalidation, take profit at the frozen pre-anchor 60-session old high when legally reached after T+1; otherwise exit at the first legal open at or after 40 held market sessions.
compressed_economic_rules.economic_meaning: The old price-memory coordinate is the natural repair target; unresolved repair has a bounded capital clock.

single_extreme_warning.name: VIOLENT_REBOUND_FROM_DEEP_DAMAGE
single_extreme_warning.definition: market_median_ret20 > 0.08 AND market_median_ret60 < -0.08 AND market_positive_ret20_share > 0.70 AND market_positive_ret60_share < 0.35
single_extreme_warning.rationale: This describes a broad, violent short-horizon rebound while the medium-horizon market remains deeply damaged. It is deliberately narrow so ordinary BEAR repair and 2018-11 style medium-horizon repair are not equated with the July-August 2015 crash rebound.

causal_market_state.why_not_simple_bull_bear_filter: Profitable and losing charts both occurred in all three existing causal labels. The market state describes opportunity habitat; individual post-resolution acceptance remains mandatory.

execution.exit: strictly later legal open for close-generated invalidation; target may fill intraday only after T+1
execution.corporate_action_contract: QD-010 exact coordinate lineage; fail closed on a blocking or unresolved change

no_rescue: no neighboring anchor, base, turnover, confirmation, target, or holding parameters
